assign.outcome: **fal.ai research landed: MVP ships with no AI; when AI lands, fal is scoped to image/video/3D/audio only, never a browser-held key.** 46-entry log.jsonl (28 established / 11 contested / 1 fringe / 7 speculation) covers the fal.ai catalogue + pricing, the queue API and MCP (why a browser can never hold it), the safe `/api/generate` key-handling shape, topic-draft cost via Claude direct (not fal's OpenRouter-proxied any-llm), moderation (Perspective API is sunsetting 2026-12-31 -- ruled out), licensing tension on FLUX.1 dev, and a Workers-AI-vs-fal split. verdict.md carries the MVP call, the key-handling §33 decision record, three cited numbers, and the cut-first order. Left open: exact per-user/day dollar caps (a product decision, not a vendor fact), and fal's own background-remover/Wizper unit prices, which render through a client-side calculator this session could not read statically twice.
